card.statement:
Let $\lambda\in X_{*}(T)^{+}$, and let $X\subset\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}$ be a closed $T$ -invariant subvariety. Then

$\dim(X)\leq\max_{\begin{subarray}{c}\mu\in X_{*}(T)\\
L_{\mu}\in X\end{subarray}}\langle\rho,\lambda+\mu\rangle.$
card.label: Corollary 5.4

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
